anya (sec-eng): Seeing increased TLS handshake failures in ap-southeast after yesterday's cipher hardening. Short stack: 
client_hello shows TLS1.2 + RSA suites, server rejects.
rob (infra): Which deploy touched certs/keys? We had rotator run at 03:00 UTC in apac.
sam (edge): We removed RSA-CBC suites globally. Canary passed but looks like some devices still insist on RSA.
anya (sec-eng): Also spotted one KMS AccessDenied for edge-service when hot-reloading cert at 03:02 UTC: AccessDeniedException kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:...:key/def456
opsbot: incident created #INC-2026-4999 region=ap-southeast severity=low-availability
rob (infra): Quick plan: 1) temporary region-scoped RSA fallback on LB (canary 5%), 2) add kms:Decrypt for key def456 to edge-role scoped to ap-southeast, 3) add IAM-check gate to rotator pipeline.
sam (edge): Pushing canary now, nginx snippet toggled to include RSA for ap-southeast only.
opsbot: canary deploy started deploy_id=canary-5181234000-1
anya (sec-eng): Add telemetry to capture ClientHello fingerprints and client IPs; product should reach out to affected customers.
rob (infra): Opening IAM PR with region condition and short TTL on allowance. Will attach CloudTrail evidence.
audit-bot: rotation event logged rot-20260320-0300, audit_id=audit-5181234000-1
sam (edge): Canary reduced failures for flagged IPs. Will keep fallback <=24h and remove after verifying no new traffic.
anya (sec-eng): Post-incident actions: telemetry, rotator IAM validation, customer outreach template. Closing for now unless error rate rises. :white_check_mark:
